- get_public_record: The API powered by PropMix provides Public Record data of a Property. Returns the Public Record Details of the given property
- verify_email_address: This endpoint verifies the validity of an email address. It checks the email address format, domain, and whether it is a disposable email address. It then extracts the MX records from the domain's DNS
- send_email: Mailgun is a programmable email platform. It allows your application to become a fully featured email server. Send, receive and track messages with ease using your favorite programming language.. Allo
